configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: Qt from the distribution or aqt: add its folder to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH in CMakeUserPresets.json.

configurePresets.name: linux-asan
configurePresets.displayName: Linux with AddressSanitizer and UBSan (the tests)
configurePresets.description: Its own build folder, build-asan; ctest --preset linux-asan runs the tests it builds. Warnings are not errors here: GCC warns of bounds in its own headers under the sanitizers, and linux-ci holds the code to its warnings. GCC finds no constant in a constexpr comparison with nullptr under the null checks (db/sync_tables.hpp), so they are off; AddressSanitizer still reports a null read.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: brew install cmake ninja pkg-config qt mpv ffmpeg openssl. HOMEBREW_PREFIX comes from `brew shellenv`. Homebrew's openssl is keg-only, so it is named here: the one Qt's TLS backend loads, not a versioned openssl@N.

configurePresets.name: ubuntu-24.04-deb
configurePresets.description: What the release workflow packages, on Ubuntu 24.04: Qt from aqt (add its folder to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH), carried with the program in /opt/seventhslide, as Ubuntu's is below the 6.8 floor. cpack --config build-package/CPackConfig.cmake makes build-package/deploy/seventhslide-ubuntu-24.04-amd64.deb.

configurePresets.name: ubuntu-26.04-deb
configurePresets.description: What the release workflow packages, on Ubuntu 26.04 with the packages docs/BUILDING.md lists and Ubuntu's Qt 6 development packages, in /usr. cpack --config build-package/CPackConfig.cmake makes build-package/deploy/seventhslide-ubuntu-26.04-amd64.deb.

configurePresets.name: fedora-rpm
configurePresets.description: What the release workflow packages, on Fedora with the packages docs/BUILDING.md lists and rpm-build. cpack --config build-package/CPackConfig.cmake makes build-package/deploy/seventhslide-fedora-x86_64.rpm.

configurePresets.name: macos-dmg
configurePresets.description: What the release workflow packages: cmake --build build-package --target macos_app makes build-package/deploy/SeventhSlide.dmg.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: Run from a Visual Studio x64 developer prompt. Without pkg-config, set SEVENTHSLIDE_MPV_ROOT and SEVENTHSLIDE_FFMPEG_ROOT (or CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH) in CMakeUserPresets.json; with vcpkg, set CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE there.

configurePresets.name: windows-mingw
configurePresets.description: Run from the MSYS2 UCRT64 shell, with mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-{qt6,mpv,ffmpeg,openssl,pkgconf,cmake,ninja}.

configurePresets.name: windows-ci
configurePresets.displayName: Windows CI (MSYS2 UCRT64, Release, warnings are errors)

configurePresets.name: windows-exe
configurePresets.description: What the release workflow packages, from the MSYS2 UCRT64 shell: packaging/windows/deploy.sh gathers the program and every DLL it needs, and packaging/windows/seventhslide.iss (Inno Setup) makes the installer.

testPresets.name: linux-asan
testPresets.description: The core, media and sync tests under the sanitizers, each given 300 seconds, as on macOS. Leaks are not looked for: Qt, fontconfig and mpv keep what they allocate until the process ends. Left out: the test that uses up every file descriptor, as UBSan then cannot open the pipe it reads memory through, and says a sound object has no vptr; and those that give the player or the link a fixed time, which the sanitizers' slowness outruns (mpv's calls in 50 ms; a snapshot's parts checked within a run of 400 ms). Each is named whole, so a test whose name starts as one does is still run.

exclude.name: ^(A computer that ran out of open files takes connections again once it has some|No player call waits on mpv while a video starts, seeks or loops|A large join through the node keeps waiting while its snapshot's parts come|A file too large to pass between computers is not sent, and is said once|A snapshot's parts are asked for at once, not behind the media asked for|A part damaged where it is sent from is set aside there, and said missing|A snapshot whose sender sends no part for a while is fetched from another)$
